analyzer.shared.secretDependentBranch

Secret Dependent Branch object.

Classes

SecretDependentBranch(expr)

Object that represents a Spectre transmission gadget, via a secret dependent branch, with all the properties that can be extracted by our analysis.

SecretDependentBranchExpr(pc, expr, ...)

Symbolic expression representing a potential secret dependent branch.
